description: This source file defines the CLIInstallPrompter class responsible for prompting the user to install the OpenClaw CLI within a macOS app. It manages user prompts, checks installation status, and initiates installation if needed. It also includes a StatusBox actor for managing status messages asynchronously.

classes.name: CLIInstallPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for prompting CLI installation, managing user interactions, and initiating installation procedures.

classes.name: StatusBox
classes.description: An actor encapsulating status message management asynchronously, used internally within CLIInstallPrompter.

methods.name: checkAndPromptIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks conditions and prompts the user to install the CLI if necessary.

methods.name: shouldPrompt
methods.description: Determines whether the application should prompt the user based on current state and version.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Handles the installation process of the CLI asynchronously and displays a completion alert.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the application settings window on a specified tab.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current app version from the bundle info dictionary.
